args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and the rollup/report links). In production this env var apparently isn't set, so reset emails point users at localhost.

Proposed fix: stop relying on a raw env var with a localhost default here. Instead, source the public URL from the shared config module (e.g. config.publicUrl) the same way resetTokenTtlMinutes is sourced from config.auth, and have that config value fail fast (throw or fail validation at startup) if it's missing in a deployed environment rather than silently defaulting to localhost. This ensures password reset, rollup, and export links always resolve to the correct public host.
